admin.keys_help: Paste each channel key from your linkrobins.com dashboard → Chirp — one per channel. Every channel powers ONE standing voice channel plus one live broadcast at a time, so more voice channels on this forum means more channels here. Remove a key to disconnect its channel.
admin.connected: ✓ Connected — you're live-ready. Moderators can go live on any discussion; members can take the mic up to your channel's speaker slots.
admin.disconnected: Not connected yet. Paste a channel key below — get one from your linkrobins.com dashboard → Chirp.
admin.service_url_help: Only change this if support asks you to.
admin.appearance_help: Default keeps Chirp's own coral-and-teal accents. Flarum adopts your forum's Appearance colors (primary and secondary color) instead, so the bars blend into your site. The green "mic is live" cues stay the same either way.
admin.policy_help: Who can take the mic in new live rooms. The host can change this live from the room's toolbar. "Raise hand" means listeners request and the host approves; "Author only" limits the stage to the discussion's author (hosts and moderators can always speak).
admin.channels_help: Standing voice rooms, Discord-style: designate a discussion and its voice bar stays open until you remove it here. Each of your channels powers one voice channel — want more standing rooms, add another channel on your linkrobins.com dashboard. Voice channels never block Go live and are never recorded.
admin.channels_slots: {used} of {total} channels power a voice channel.
admin.channels_exhausted: Every channel already powers a voice channel. Add another channel on your linkrobins.com dashboard, paste its key above, and you can designate more.
admin.channels_confirm_remove: Remove this voice channel? Everyone in it gets disconnected and the discussion goes back to normal.
admin.record_help: When your channel has the recordings add-on, every room is recorded and the audio lands in the discussion as a post when the room ends — stored on this forum, not on our servers. This switch only takes effect when the add-on is active on your channel (re-save your channel key after changing the add-on so this forum notices).

permissions.take_mic_label: Speak in a live audio room
